# ZHB: Zentrale Hochschulbibliothek Lübeck

> The central university library of the University of Lübeck, providing comprehensive access to academic resources, research databases, and digital collections.

ZHB Lübeck is the primary academic library serving the University of Lübeck community. It offers integrated access to catalogs, e-journals, e-books, and interlibrary loan services through modern digital platforms and research terminals.

## Key Topics

- Zentrale Hochschulbibliothek Lübeck
- Library Catalog (GVK/K10plus)
- Research Terminal
- E-Resources Access
- Journal Databases (EZB)
- Interlibrary Loan
- Digital Collections
- Open Access
- Academic Library Services
- Resource Discovery
- E-Book Access
- German Library Network (GBV)
- Research Support

## Main Library Services

- [ZHB Homepage](https://www.zhb.uni-luebeck.de): Central University Library Lübeck main portal for research and resource access
- [ZHB Homepage (Index)](https://www.zhb.uni-luebeck.de/index.php): ZHB Lübeck homepage with catalog search, e-resources, and library services

## Research & Discovery Tools

- [Research Terminal](https://www.zhb.uni-luebeck.de/en/research-terminal/?op=webseite): Research terminal interface for library catalog, databases, and e-journals access
- [Library Information & Services](https://www.zhb.uni-luebeck.de/zentrale-hochschulbibliothek/?op=webseite): Library information page detailing services, borrowing, and electronic resources
